context: Routing requests to the correct skill and reusing existing candidate files instead of repeating searches.

checklist.name: Existing candidate file reused
checklist.description: The agent reads /tmp/crispr-candidates.json and presents its contents instead of running a new PubMed search.

checklist.name: No redundant search
checklist.description: The agent does not run pubmed_search.py search for CRISPR gene therapy again.

checklist.name: Known DOI routed to triage-paper
checklist.description: The agent sends the DOI request straight to triage-paper without running a PubMed search first.

checklist.name: Triage still confirmed
checklist.description: The agent confirms with the user before triaging when the candidate list is involved.

checklist.name: CS literature routed away from PubMed
checklist.description: The agent recognises that transformer architectures papers are general academic literature, not biomedical.

checklist.name: Correct alternative named
checklist.description: The agent uses google-scholar-search or semantic-scholar-search for the computer science request.

checklist.name: Candidates presented as a list
checklist.description: The existing candidates are shown as a list for the user to review, with titles and PMIDs where present.

checklist.name: No analysis performed unprompted
checklist.description: The agent does not run analyze or download on the candidates without being asked.

checklist.name: Handoff question asked
checklist.description: The agent asks which candidates, if any, the user wants to triage.

checklist.name: Routing explained briefly
checklist.description: The agent explains in a sentence or two why each request goes to a different skill.

checklist.name: No MCP assumed
checklist.description: The agent does not claim an MCP server is available when none is configured.
